# spaceman run

Runs: list, show, launch and stop (--space).

Aliases: `runs`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman run get`](#spaceman-run-get) | Show a run |
| [`spaceman run launch`](#spaceman-run-launch) | Launch a run on the space's node |
| [`spaceman run list`](#spaceman-run-list) | A space's runs, newest first |
| [`spaceman run stop`](#spaceman-run-stop) | Stop a run |

## spaceman run get

Show a run.

```sh
spaceman run get <run> [flags]
```

API: `get-run` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman run launch

Launch a run on the space's node.

```sh
spaceman run launch [flags]
```

API: `launch-run` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman run launch --space payments --role worker --prompt-file task.md
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--account` | string |  | account ID to use |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--harness` | string |  | claude-code or codex (default: the role's) |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--instance` | string |  | instance ID |
| `--kind` | string |  | control, worker, kb, dreamer or diagnostic |
| `--model` | string |  | model override |
| `--prompt` | string |  | first prompt |
| `--prompt-file` | string |  | read --prompt from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--role` | string |  | space role to run (required) |
| `--session` | string |  | native session to resume |
| `--setting` | string, repeatable |  | harness setting (key=value, repeatable) |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--workspace` | string |  | workspace path inside the space |
| `--worktree-base` | string |  | worktree base ref |
| `--worktree-branch` | string |  | worktree branch |
| `--worktree-repo` | string |  | repository of a dedicated worktree |

## spaceman run list

A space's runs, newest first.

```sh
spaceman run list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-runs` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer |  | maximum number of items |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman run stop

Stop a run.

```sh
spaceman run stop <run> [flags]
```

API: `stop-run` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--mode` | string |  | interrupt (default) or kill |
| `--reason` | string |  | reason, recorded with the run |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
